notes: thy way has no suffix in the Hebrew, so the possessive is the article's rendering under rule 41.

ʿal māh and lənegdî each fuse under rule 30 and head on the morpheme carrying the content — the interrogative and the spatial neged; heading them on the opening preposition, as rule 23 does for kaʾăšer and mēʿal, is the competing reading.
